body: The Minimalist Escape camper van is a one-of-a-kind, custom-built retreat created specifically to fulfill the unique vision of our client. Designed with simplicity, functionality, and off-grid capability in mind, this build was tailored to embody the essence of minimalist living while providing every essential comfort. Outfitted with a 300W solar system and a robust 400Ah lithium battery bank, it offers reliable, eco-conscious power for seamless off-grid experiences. Multiple 110V outlets with USB-C ports and a powerful 3000W inverter allow for device charging, cooking, and power access throughout the van.

The heart of the Minimalist Escape lies in its carefully designed interior. From the 33-gallon water tank and Laveo dry flush toilet to an energy-efficient 4-gallon hot water heater, every detail ensures practicality and ease. The acacia butcher block countertop and stainless steel sink bring warmth to the kitchen, which also features a Zuvo water purification unit and portable induction cooktop for a sleek, modern feel. Dimmable LED lighting, swivel seating, and ample storage further enhance the van’s streamlined, clutter-free aesthetic.

Custom-fitted with an Espar diesel heater, Maxxair Deluxe vent fan, and Nomadic X2 12V AC unit, this van provides a comfortable environment in any climate. Its painted shiplap siding, stained wood ceiling, and vinyl flooring blend practicality with style, making it a cozy, travel-ready retreat.
